verdict.rationale: Docs describe an AI editor board where founders can see every page, give instructions, and get AI-generated design previews before changes are applied (base44-docs-12, base44-docs-14), and natural-language editing updates code/styles live (base44-docs-33), implying an in-progress live preview prior to publishing. However, there is no explicit 'live preview' feature name, no screenshots/hands-on walkthrough of the preview pane, and no independent confirmation of this specific pre-publish preview workflow. missing for 10: explicit documentation naming a live/instant preview feature, independent hands-on corroboration of previewing unpublished changes, detail on how preview differs from the published app.
